posts.name: MindWanderer
posts.cooked:
I believe I can quote the ARG without it counting as a spoiler:

"You will fight it.  Use what I have told you.  Eventually, it will call me to fight you.  But I know how tenacious and resourceful you can be.  I will be there when you weaken it, and I will have its power for my own."

On the Harpy shipping question, I’d like to think that while Lilian was in prison, some villainess took up a protectorship of the newly incarcerated and young and vulnerable Matriarch, and later on they ended up having to fight but were hesitant to hurt each other. I have a hard time finding candidates to name, since while there’s close to gender parity between male and female main villains, the “mooks” villains are predominantly masculine, and a lot of the exceptions I can think of wouldn’t really work (Highbrow, Calypso, Ammut, two of the Crackjaw Crew, various Citizens).

Things that they didn’t include in the MultiVerse which they were excited about…I can’t believe they didn’t mention Fashion, who we still don’t have even in Disparation.

“Shame Boy” lol. Shots fired!
